label.zh-TW: App Store：浪LIVE直播（開發者網站為 lang.live）
label.en: App Store: 浪LIVE (developer website on lang.live)

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（會前往浪LIVE 官方網域 lang.live 的分享頁；沒有邀請碼，邀請人資訊已在網址中）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (a share page on the official lang.live domain; there is no code, as the referrer is already in the address).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面與 App 內的指示註冊或登入浪LIVE；App Store 的年齡分級為 18+，官方條款另有行為能力與法定代理人同意的規定，註冊前請先自行確認是否適合使用。
steps.en: Register or log in to 浪LIVE as the app directs; it is rated 18+ on the App Store and the terms have legal-capacity rules, so check that it suits you first.

steps.zh-TW: 沒有邀請碼可輸入；若開啟連結後沒有看到邀請人名稱「浪客_7206394」，請回到本頁重新開啟連結。
steps.en: There is no code to type in. If the referrer name “浪客_7206394” is not shown after opening the link, reopen it from this page.

intro.zh-TW: 透過邀請人專屬連結開啟浪LIVE，這是歌唱直播 App；連結沒有另外的邀請碼，直接開啟即可。
intro.en: Open 浪LIVE, a singing live-streaming app, via the referrer's personal link; no invite code.

description.zh-TW:
浪LIVE（英文名 LANG LIVE）是台灣的歌唱直播 App。App 可免費下載，站內另有以浪花儲值、贈送禮物與付費會員等需要付費的項目。分享文案稱它為「看浪Live」，連結則指向浪LIVE 官方網域 lang.live。

這是邀請人專屬的邀請連結，網址中的 pfid 參數標示邀請人，沒有另外的邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結開啟。分享文案提到會送金幣，但沒有說明被邀請人可得的具體獎勵，本站也沒有找到官方的邀請獎勵說明，所以本頁不列出優惠。

官方條款表示，金幣等代幣除條款另有規定外不能兌換為現金，相關說法請以官方條款為準。App Store 的年齡分級為 18+，儲值與送禮都是真實花費，請量力而為。
description.en:
浪LIVE (LANG LIVE) is a Taiwan-based singing live-streaming app. The app is free to download, and in-app purchases include a virtual currency called 浪花, gifts and paid memberships. The share text calls it 看浪Live, while the link points to the official lang.live domain.

This is the referrer's personal invite link. The pfid parameter in the address identifies the referrer and there is no separate invite code, so open the link on this page directly. The share text mentions that the app gives coins (金幣) but does not describe a concrete reward for the invited person, and no official invite reward description was found, so no offer is listed here.

The official terms say that tokens such as coins cannot be exchanged for cash except where the terms provide otherwise; follow the official terms on this point. The Taiwan App Store rates the app 18+, and top-ups and gifts cost real money, so spend within your means.

notes.zh-TW:
這是邀請人專屬連結，沒有可手動輸入的邀請碼；邀請人由網址的 pfid 參數（7206394）標示，網址原樣保留。2026-10-24 維運者用瀏覽器開啟分享連結：頁面載入於 lang.live 的子網域 web.lang.live，只顯示邀請人名稱，沒有邀請碼欄位，也沒有獎勵說明。註冊時邀請關係是否被平台接受，沒有測試。

分享文案沒有說明被邀請人可得的具體獎勵，本站也沒有找到浪LIVE 的邀請計畫說明或條款，所以不列出優惠；是否有獎勵與條件，以註冊畫面與官方公告為準。

金幣與現金：分享文案稱金幣每晚自動轉為現金。官方條款（2025-11-10 更新）說明，金幣等代幣除條款另有規定外不能兌換為現金；條款中的現金提領須依另訂的提領辦法，本站沒有找到公開的提領辦法。本站不把這項說法當作優惠，也不保證任何收益，請以官方條款為準。

年齡與消費：App Store 的年齡分級為 18+，標示的內容含虛擬物品抽獎機制、使用者內容與聊天。條款沒有訂定數字年齡，但規定沒有行為能力者須由法定代理人申請，限制行為能力者須經法定代理人同意。浪花儲值、送禮與會員都是真實花費；條款說明浪花原則上除法律另有規定外不予退款，App Store 也列有自動續訂的訂閱項目。條款另禁止私下以現金交易浪花，以及買賣或出借帳號。

網域與名稱：本站只確認 lang.live 及其子網域屬於浪LIVE，名稱相近的直播網站不一定相關；請只透過官方網域或 App 商店上的官方上架頁面下載。撰寫本頁時（2026-10-24），本站以網路搜尋查詢，沒有找到關於浪LIVE 的 165 反詐騙或主管機關警示，但這並非直接查詢 165 網站，也不是官方保證。
notes.en:
This is the referrer's personal link with no invite code to type in; the referrer is identified by the pfid parameter (7206394) in the address, which is kept exactly as shared. On 2026-10-24 the maintainer opened the share link in a browser: the page loaded on web.lang.live, a subdomain of lang.live, and showed only the referrer's name, with no invite code field and no reward text. Whether the platform accepts the referral at sign-up was not tested.

The share text does not describe a concrete reward for the invited person and no invite program description or terms for 浪LIVE were found, so no offer is listed. Whether any reward exists and under what conditions follow the sign-up screens and the official announcements.

Coins and cash: the share text says coins are turned into cash automatically every night. The official terms (updated 2025-11-10) say that tokens such as 金幣 (coins) cannot be exchanged for cash except where the terms provide otherwise; cash withdrawal under the terms follows a separate withdrawal policy, which this site could not find published. This site does not treat that statement as an offer and does not promise any earnings; follow the official terms.

Age and spending: the App Store rates the app 18+ and flags loot-box-style virtual item mechanics, user-generated content and chat. The terms set no numeric age, but say a person without legal capacity must apply through a legal representative and a person with limited capacity needs the representative's consent. Top-ups (浪花), gifts and memberships cost real money; the terms say 浪花 is generally not refundable except where the law requires, and the App Store lists auto-renewing subscriptions. The terms also prohibit private cash trades of 浪花 and buying, selling or lending accounts.

Domain and name: this site only confirmed lang.live and its subdomains as belonging to 浪LIVE, and similarly named streaming sites are not necessarily related; download only through the official domain or the official app store listing. When this page was written (2026-10-24), web searches found no 165 anti-fraud notice or regulator warning about 浪LIVE, but this was not a direct query of the 165 site and is not an official assurance.

q.zh-TW: 浪LIVE 的邀請連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need to enter an invite code for the 浪LIVE invite link?

a.zh-TW: 不需要。分享文案沒有提供邀請碼，連結以網址中的 pfid 參數（7206394）標示邀請人，這個編號與浪LIVE 官網上名稱為 `浪客_7206394` 的公開頁面一致。開啟分享頁時只顯示邀請人名稱，沒有輸入邀請碼的欄位。請直接透過本頁連結開啟。
a.en: No. The share text provides no code, and the link identifies the referrer through the pfid parameter (7206394), which matches the public page named `浪客_7206394` on the official 浪LIVE site. The share page showed only the referrer's name and had no field for an invite code. Just open the link on this page.

q.zh-TW: 浪LIVE 的邀請連結有優惠嗎？分享文案提到的金幣是什麼？
q.en: Does the 浪LIVE invite link come with an offer, and what are the coins in the share text?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案只提到會送金幣，沒有說明被邀請人可得的具體獎勵，也找不到官方的邀請獎勵說明，所以本頁不列出優惠。依官方條款，金幣屬於其他代幣，可透過完成任務、購買會員或購買虛擬禮物取得，且除條款另有規定外不能兌換為現金。實際規則以浪LIVE 官方條款為準。
a.en: The share text only says the app gives coins and does not describe a concrete reward for the invited person; no official invite reward description was found either, so no offer is listed on this page. Under the official terms, coins are one of the “other tokens”, which can be obtained by completing tasks, buying memberships or buying virtual gifts, and which cannot be exchanged for cash except where the terms provide otherwise. Actual rules follow the official terms of 浪LIVE.
